questions.q: Statements: The Cabinet of State X took certain steps to tackle the milk glut in the state as the cooperatives and government dairies failed to use the available milk. - A news report. Conclusions: The milk production of State X is more than its need. The Government and co-operative dairies in State X are not equipped in terms of resources and technology to handle such excess milk.
